reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: The app is not posting. Contacted support twice. The canned return message says they will contact me in two days or so. It’s been a week. Horrible. I used this app in the past and came back. Will leave again 😡

reviews.title: The app freeze after downloading percent reach 100. It stays there until I close the app and re open
Worked at first..
reviews.text: i used this for few months now and worked great…then suddenly today, no images were showing and kept saying reload because the pics were from a old import?? that made no sense, i resetted the app twice, even restarted my phone and nothing…nonsense

reviews.title: Failure to capture full time
reviews.text: App fails each time to capture the first second or two of instagram clips so the clip is downloaded missing a part of it

reviews.title: Need to make trim better
reviews.text: The trim feature should allow for edits anywhere in the reel. It should also be made larger to be easier to see the exact spot of the edit. I should not have to constantly restart the reel from the beginning to fine tune my edit. Also, a timeline should be clearly visible.

reviews.title: The app not working
reviews.text: The app stopped functioning. The repost feature sometimes not automatically opening. Take very long time to open other screens on the app. The buttons are not functioning properly. User friendliness is zero. It’s not worth paying for this. It said 3 days free trial but you charged me for one week fees after I downloaded the app which is unfair.
